sections.heading: A center on a list of four
A name with a bilateral history

central_finding.quote: Four governments have adopted as a shared goal a name that the United States and the Philippines have used for a bilateral coordination structure since at least 2024.

establishes.quote: Neither version says where the center will be, how it will be organized or when it will open.
broke ground on a new combined coordination center at Camp Aguinaldo

uncertain.quote: As of Nov. 13, no government had said publicly which of these it is.
The public record does not show a four-way framework for classified information
